plugins.name: graft-robotics
plugins.description: Universal Graft Robotics v0.5.0 MCP App & Workbench (19 MCP tools, 7 operational Playbooks, 4 Form Elicitations, 5 live Resources, PreToolUse Hooks): ROS 2 Pre-Flight Launch Bundle generator, opt-in Cloudflare D1 Hosted Fleet Vault status (zero phone-home when unset), 6-client Agent Connect (Claude, Antigravity, Codex, Gemini, Apple MLX, Gemma 4), 1-click ISO 10218:2025 & EU 2023/1230 Compliance Dossier ZIP (0 private keys), live Wedge A-Upmarket Workbench, 6-family Hand HAL, Rust graft-core + MuJoCo 4.0.1 physics, Semantic-to-Deterministic Ratchet, and fail-closed L0-L3 Trust Ladder.
mcpApps: Graft Robotics Workbench (ui://graft-robotics/workbench.html, aux_pane, global, Claude MCP App)
suggestedPrompts: Run /ros2-compliance-audit to generate a ROS 2 pre-flight bundle, verify compliance-pack ZIP, and check Fleet Vault status
Call graft_connect_agent to connect Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, Gemini, Apple MLX, or Gemma 4 to my UR5e cell in L0 OBSERVE
Open the Graft Robotics Workbench side pane and download graft-compliance-pack.zip
Run /remote-shop-onboarding to generate a zero-FDE CNC or shop-floor onboarding kit and 48h L0 shadow trial
Run /semantic-hazard-ratchet to crystallize an unlabeled chemical hazard into a permanent deterministic rule
